name: RAM GANGRADE
summary: SDET / QA Automation Engineer with 4+ years driving measurable quality gains - 60% lower regression effort, 40% higher automation coverage, and 15% fewer production defects - by designing and maintaining reusable test automation frameworks in Java with Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, Cypress, RestAssured, TestNG, and JUnit for web, API, and mobile applications. Builds and runs regression and end-to-end suites in CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD), containerizes test environments with Docker within Agile/Scrum teams, and validates releases to reduce production defects. Deep working knowledge of FinTech, Banking, Healthcare, SaaS, and GenAI domains, applying regulatory and compliance-aware testing across financial, banking, and healthcare workflows. Progressive track record advancing from QA Engineer to Senior SDET across four roles.
skills: Automation: Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, BrowserStack, Sauce Labs
API Testing: RestAssured, Postman, REST API Automation
Testing Frameworks: TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber (BDD), Gherkin, Mocha, Page Object Model, Data-Driven, Hybrid
CI/CD & DevOps: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Maven, Gradle
Testing Methodologies: Agile, Scrum, BDD, Functional, Regression, Smoke, Integration, End-to-End, Mobile, Cross-Browser
Domains: FinTech, Banking, Healthcare, SaaS, GenAI

bullets: Drove a 60% drop in regression execution effort and faster release validation by architecting scalable, reusable test automation frameworks with Java, TestNG, JUnit, and Selenium WebDriver for a SaaS application spanning server- and client-side systems.
Removed manual test orchestration by running test suites inside containerized Docker setups and orchestrating execution across Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
Guaranteed stable weekly releases by diagnosing and resolving CI/CD pipeline failures while sustaining reliable, high-availability regression execution.
Cut production defects by 15% and raised build quality through release-based validation that verified full compatibility and uptime across deployment cycles.
Expanded automation coverage by 40% and trimmed manual testing by 50% through end-to-end and system-level test plans across web and API layers.
Slashed test effort by 40% by building Cypress and Mocha setups for cross-browser end-to-end automation.
Boosted API test reliability by 20% with REST API test suites in RestAssured and Postman that validate responses and API contracts.
Halved regression cycle times by shipping a reusable data-driven Selenium + TestNG framework in Java.
Shortened automation onboarding time and improved maintainability with a modular hybrid framework (Java + TestNG + Maven) built from reusable components.
Fostered stronger collaboration among QA engineers, developers, and business stakeholders by implementing BDD automation with Cucumber and Gherkin.
Reached 40% automation coverage of regression test cases with Selenium and Java, enabling faster, repeatable release validation.
Lowered post-release defects by 10% through thorough functional, UI, and regression testing.

projects.name: Huma - AI-Powered HR SaaS Platform | Test Automation (SaaS)
projects.meta: Playwright, pytest, FastAPI, React, REST API, Groq AI
bullets: Built end-to-end Playwright workflow coverage for a FastAPI + React HR SaaS platform, spanning 14+ modules (recruitment, payroll, attendance, AI agent, candidate scoring) and 100+ REST API endpoints.

Designed and ran a 320+ test suite (unit, integration, E2E, functional, security, load) using pytest and Playwright, validating authentication, role-based access, API contracts, and business workflows.

Performed API load and performance testing, measuring ~45ms p50, ~120ms p95, and ~350ms p99 response times with ~200 req/s throughput, and documented bottlenecks with remediation (file locking, unbounded chat history).
Authored test, bug, security, and performance reports; validated JWT + bcrypt auth and RBAC across admin, manager, and junior roles.

projects.name: HIPAA - Healthcare API Security Validation Platform (Healthcare)
projects.meta: Python, OpenAPI/Swagger, HIPAA, FHIR, XSS/SQLi/JWT, OWASP ZAP, Playwright, Docker
bullets: Developed a healthcare API security validation platform that parses OpenAPI specs, maps findings to 12 HIPAA CFR rules across 17 risk types, and detects PHI exposure plus invalid FHIR and ICD-10 data.
Engineered eight security engines - XSS payload injection, SQL injection via sqlmap, JWT and jwt_tool checks, OWASP ZAP passive/active scanning, RBAC privilege-escalation, and CSRF validation.
Maintained 83 unit tests and 62 Playwright workflow tests; delivered JSON/HTML HIPAA compliance reports and containerized the scanner with Docker.

projects.name: Self-Healing AI Test Automation Framework (GenAI)
projects.meta: Playwright, Groq/OpenAI LLMs, LangChain, GitHub Actions, Node.js
bullets: Designed an AI-driven Playwright automation framework that auto-generates test scenarios and heals broken locators at runtime using Groq/OpenAI LLMs and LangChain.
Implemented a snapshot-based regression agent and selector-healing agent with an orchestrator for self-healing reruns across frontend, UI, responsive, and grammar test suites.
Integrated tests into a GitHub Actions CI workflow that provisions Playwright browsers, runs suites on push/PR, and uploads HTML reports as build artifacts.
